parameters.name: AckAdmin
parameters.description: Specifies whether the cluster is managed by an ACK cluster.

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

- **true**: Auto-renewal is enabled.
- **false**: Auto-renewal is not enabled.

Default value: **false**.

> This parameter takes effect only when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.

parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically use coupons. Valid values:
* true (default): Use coupons.
* false: Do not use coupons.

parameters.name: CreatePublicEndpoint
parameters.description: Specifies whether to create a public endpoint.

parameters.name: DBClusterDescription
parameters.description: The cluster description. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the PolarDB instance on which the application depends.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Valid values: 

- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.
- **Prepaid**: subscription.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
This parameter is required to pass parameter when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**. Specifies the unit of the upfront payment duration for the subscription cluster. 

- **Year**: The subscription duration is measured in years.
- **Month**: The subscription duration is measured in months.

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code. If this parameter is not specified, the default coupon is used.

sub_parameters.name: BeginTime
sub_parameters.description: The start time of the task. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format (UTC).

sub_parameters.name: EndTime
sub_parameters.description: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time. The time is in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ` format (UTC).

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description:
This parameter is required when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.
- If **Period** is set to **Month**, the valid values of **UsedTime** are integers in the range of `[1-9]`.
- If **Period** is set to **Year**, the valid values of **UsedTime** are integers in the range of `[1-3]`.
